svg.text: Hold a track-select button ~0.2 s. Example: 16-step pattern, channel 10, 1/16 rate.
Pattern length - tap a step = new last step
Patterns: tap = view/edit, hold = chain | Gate length
MIDI channel 1-16 (Ch 9-16 upper row, Ch 1-8 lower)
Pattern pads: white = playing now, green = chained, red = not chained; a blue tint marks the one you are editing.
Everything here is per track (pattern length is per pattern) and saved to flash with Setup.
